scientific_integrity: The mathematical argument gives a complete gap-collision classification and finite-length counts. One standard-library checker was run on all source necklaces with up to 36 zeros and on 450 additional random larger examples. Novelty comparisons are best-knowledge assessments, not guarantees.
scientific_limitations: Binary cyclic words with exactly three ones; exact single deletion; outputs identified under rotation, not reversal. The formulas do not determine trace probabilities, recovery from one observation, higher-deletion spheres, or higher fixed weights. The finite checker corroborates rather than proves the infinite result. An equivalent enumeration may exist in unindexed literature.
title: The complete one-deletion spectrum of three-marker binary necklaces
